name: console-chat-loading-notice
goal: Describe a pending project connection without claiming read-only access

evidence: While a project connection is pending the composer is disabled but its notice incorrectly says read-only. Loading, connection errors and confirmed read-only access need distinct messages.
The existing console loading capture asserted only the disabled composer. The catalog and existing project-agent store test now check the notice and preserve error and read-only cases.
The committed loading catalog assertion failed on harbor-mbp-2; the desktop unit test also observed the incorrect read-only notice.
Show a loading notice while the workspace is busy, after prioritizing connection errors; annotate the store factory return type.
